name: @dangerboi/kata-omp
description: Kata plans and subagent tracking for oh-my-pi
author: Dangerboi

defaultProject.description: Existing Kata project that collects the plans of folders without a project, labeled with the repo. Empty: the folder's inferred project.

liveInbox.description: Deliver inbox requests to the main session as they arrive. Off: read the inbox once per turn.

refGuard.description: block refuses a write, edit or git commit that puts a Kata ref the session works into the repository; off lets it through.
